motivation.LAB18_quality: Independent LAB19 PASS, 36/36 wins, +0.5862257302 dB mean vs v01.
motivation.LAB18_physical_cost: Physical timing capture shows +71.48% vs v01 by whole-run reported medians; two clock regimes were observed but both show a large LAB18 penalty.
motivation.decision: Do not promote LAB18 unchanged. Optimize cost first.

constraints.texture_contract: exactly 1 GatherGreen + 4 SampleLevel, 0 UAV, no intermediate texture

stage_A_exact_branch.goal: Move MC evaluation behind an exact admission==0 early return without changing LAB18's gate or admitted-pixel algebra.
required_gates: D3D11 WARP parity against LAB18 reference
output difference against frozen LAB18 no greater than existing numerical parity tolerance

stage_B_hard_gate_research.goal: If exact branching is insufficient, replace soft normalized admission terms with cheaper threshold predicates selected on A+B only.
stage_B_hard_gate_research.note: Consumed diagnostics may reject architecture but must not be used as a fresh final acceptance set.

hardware_policy: No new GTX 960M request until a software candidate has materially lower compiled cost and passes fresh post-freeze quality validation.
